title: Our Man in the North
start: Talk to Hassan in the Menaphos Merchant district.

recommended.t: Desert amulet 2 or above for teleport to Nardah, then run north east to Uzer Mastaba
Pollnivneach Teleport scroll, Ring of slaying, or Slayer cape teleport to Sumona

kills.l: Menaphite thug (Our Man in the North)

rewards.t: Relic of Het, gives 9625 reputation with a faction in Menaphos of your choice when handed in to a faction leader.

steps.t: Talk to Grand Vizier Hassan in the Merchant district, south of the bank deposit box. [Chat: 1 Talk about Our Man in the North. › Accept]
Go to the Grand Library of Menaphos in the Imperial district. The entrance is next to the deposit box (bank chest).
Talk to Kohnen the librarian, who is just north of the entrance. [Chat: 1 *whisper* I'm looking for a book.]
Exit the Grand Library.
Head north to talk to Commander Akhomet. [Chat: 1 Talk about Our Man in the North. › 2 Historical text and bloodlines.]
Head to Pollnivneach.
Speak to Aristarchus, who is north-west of the south magic carpet station. [Chat: 1 Talk about Our Man in the North]
You will have to fight four Menaphite Thugs.

sub.t: They are level 122 and fight using melee.
You can hide behind Aristarchus if you need a safe spot and are using ranged/magic/necromancy.

steps.t: Speak to Aristarchus again who will agree to meet you in the library. [Chat: 1 Talk about Our Man in the North]
Return to the Grand Library and speak to Aristarchus, who is south of the entrance inside the library.
Go to Uzer Mastaba and enter the pyramid to trigger a cutscene. (fairy code DLQ)
After the cutscene, enter the pyramid once more and speak to Senliten. [Chat: 4 Talk about Our Man in the North. › 4 Ozan is Senliten's descendant? › 2 Where are you going with this?]
Go to Al Kharid and speak to Osman, who is in the throne room, south of the lodestone.
p: Jabari and his clones in the palace.

steps.t: Speak to Emir Ali Mirza in front of the throne. [Chat: 1 Talk about Our Man in the North.]
Leave the Palace and head north-east to Dommik's Crafting Store.

sub.t: Ignore the quest active area marked on the minimap.

steps.t: Climb the stairs on the inside of the crafting store.
Climb the ladder south of the stairs.
Follow these steps across the rooftops:

sub.t: Walk across the plank to the south.
Slide down the awning to the south.
Go through the building.
Walk across the washing line (north-west from where you started).
Climb the ladder to the west.
Talk to Jabari.
Cross the planks to the west.
Climb the ladder to the southwest.
Jump from the scaffold to the west.
Climb down the rug to the south.
Swing across the wooden frame immediately west.
Jump from the scaffold (west) to the next building.
Bounce on the awning (south) to the bank.
Climb up the brickwork to the west on the wall.
Talk to Jabari.
Parrot drop on the rug to the south.
Do not shimmy across the rope.
Run north of the bank, west of the furnace, and talk to Jabari.
Run north-east of the Al Kharid lodestone into a tent, and talk to Jabari.
Run north to the house near the north-east exit of Al Kharid, and talk to Jabari.
You can get a free heal from the Surgeon General west of this house.

steps.t: Go to Het's Oasis.
Prepare to battle Jabari four times. He is level 112 and uses magic. He has a weakness to slash.
Talk to Jabari. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Jabari will teleport you into the centre of the arena, surrounding you with his clones.

sub.t: Choosing the wrong Jabari will cause an explosion that damages the player and scales with level.
Find the real Jabari by attacking the odd one out. As it is random for each player, it could be any of these:
The only one facing backwards.
The only one in attack position.
The one with the smallest sceptre.
The largest one of them.
The one targeted by the audience.
The one with the correctly spelled name.
The one with a different robe colour.
The one without prayer renewal particles.
The one who is not translucent.

p: Het appears and protects you from Jabari's attack.

steps.t: Talk to Het.
Talk to Emir Ali Mirza, in the Al Kharid throne room. [Chat: 1 Talk about Our Man in the North.]
After the cutscene, talk to Emir Ali Mirza again. [Chat: 1 Talk about Our Man in the North.]
Quest complete!
